thread:
maria: Customer (Acme Corp, acct-993) seeing 500s from embeddings endpoint. Root request id: req_9f3b7a2c. Happened 2026-03-14T16:23:11Z in eu-west-1. Need server-side logs + repro steps and any hints for billing spike.
alex: On it. Quick Q: is req_9f3b7a2c the full id? Also confirm region eu-west-1.
maria: Yes full id is req_9f3b7a2c. Region confirmed eu-west-1. Sample curl they used below.
maria: ```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-customer-XYZ" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"embed-large","input":"hello world"}'
```
alex: Two quick search approaches: Kibana KQL or logstore CLI. KQL example:
```kql
request_id : "req_9f3b7a2c" and region : "eu-west-1"
```
Elasticsearch body if you need it:
```json
{
  "query": {"bool": {"must": [{"term": {"request_id": "req_9f3b7a2c"}}, {"term": {"region": "eu-west-1"}}]}}
}
```
Retention note: hot tier ~30d, cold ~90d, deep-archive up to 365d for enterprise contracts. If you don't find a hit in hot, file a cold-restore.
oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-1156 created and paging #oncall-sre :rotating_light:
chun: I pulled edge traces. There's an upstream 502 that the gateway turned into 500. Try this to include status and upstream:
```kql
request_id : "req_9f3b7a2c" and (http.status_code : 502 or http.status_code : 500)
```
sre-ingest: I fetched spans with the internal CLI:
```
rb-logs fetch --req req_9f3b7a2c --from "2026-03-14T16:20:00Z" --to "2026-03-14T16:30:00Z" --output /tmp/req_9f3b7a2c.json
```
Upload: s3://support-debug/2026/03/14/req_9f3b7a2c.json
maria: Customer also reports billing spike. Any signs of duplicate retries?
alex: Ingress shows 3 identical requests from same client IP within 2s — likely client-side retry on timeout. Use this group-by to confirm:
```kql
request_id : "req_9f3b7a2c" | stats count by client_ip, user_agent
```
chun: Also check headers — sometimes proxy rotates request_id. Inspect x-redwood-req and x-forwarded-for. If auth retries happened, look for repeated 401s then 200s.
maria: I'll ask them to run rb-debug. Suggested command for customer-side capture:
```bash
rb-debug collect --req req_9f3b7a2c --include-system --out debug-req_9f3b7a2c.tar.gz
# or capture curl with -v to include full headers
```
alex: If logs are only in cold storage, open cold-restore here: https://internal.redwood.ai/cold-restore — include req id, region, time window. Typical restore ETA 2-6 hours.
sre-ingest: I attached extracted stack traces in the S3 object; timestamps show upstream connection timeout after ~10s. Opening infra ticket to check upstream health for that window. Updated INC-2026-1156.
maria: Thanks all :thumbsup: I'll forward s3 link and rb-debug instructions to customer and ask them to share the tarball when ready.
